limits: Diagnostic profiles are instrumented main-thread samples, not paired timing evidence and not measurements of all process threads. CPU shares identify where to investigate; they do not prove a cause or a speedup.

Fixture loading, warmup and JSON output serialization are excluded. Inspector-control stacks are retained in raw/all profiles but excluded from application percentages (73.49 ms/default compile, 84.78 ms/large compile). Sampling and JIT effects can still perturb execution.
Exclusive phase assignment uses the nearest declared named stage on each sampled stack; source in analyze.py makes the classification reviewable. Inclusive callers overlap and must not be added.

Allocation totals are sampled cumulative JavaScript allocations, including collected objects. They are not live memory, RSS or native WASM allocation. Earlier heap studies include fixtures and have different boundaries, so their totals are not direct comparisons.
GC is left unattributed: allocation volume at a call site does not establish that site caused a particular GC pause.
Export names come directly from the unchanged packaged WASM export section. Stripped internal function indices remain unnamed; no source-level cost or hardware cache-miss claim is made.

Other interval preparation, search, finalization and compilation

allocation.description: V8 sampled allocated bytes, including minor/major collected objects, 16KiB interval. Three separate samples after one warmup; only compileHandoff, excluding fixture loading/serialization. Not live heap, RSS, WASM allocations or timing evidence. Inclusive rows overlap.

interpretation: Compiler-native WASM accounts for 47.10% of default and 47.69% of large application samples. JavaScript/compiler work and GC account for most of the rest; the isolated solver is not the whole cost.
Replay/prefix validation accounts for 31.56%/33.61%; geometry creation and registration accounts for 17.14%/16.26%. These whole phases are better architecture targets than small helpers.

Trajectory assessment, detection, objective and candidate recording account for 12.68%/21.50%. Candidate recording alone grows from 0.94% to 8.15%; current profiles do not establish whether full-tail scoring, object construction, JIT inlining or another subpath explains the increase.

Default sampled cumulative JavaScript allocations are 886.27 MiB/compile. getCachedRawFrames self accounts for 134.50 MiB (15.18%); impact observation, strike derivation, detection and motion sampling allocate further independent intermediates. Candidate evaluation subtree accounts for 67.89% inclusively.
Model retrieval consumes approximately 5.5% of default self samples. Even eliminating it completely cannot by itself close the 22.88% reduction required from the qualified 9076.48 ns/frame baseline.

Hypothetical Amdahl calculation: holding other costs fixed, halving all compiler-native cost at its sampled 47.10% share would imply about 6939 ns/frame. This is an illustration of required scale, not a feasibility or timing claim.

from pathlib import Path
import json,collections,hashlib,subprocess,re
r=Path('/tmp/engine-cost-map-20261104')
# Interpret unchanged production function indices only through stack callers.
# Do not infer stripped Rust symbols from unrelated builds.
compiler_wasm='wasm://wasm/0005be1e'; judge_wasm='wasm://wasm/0005c092'
exports=json.loads((r/'wasm-exports.json').read_text())['functionExports']
phase_functions={
'buildGeometry':'Geometry construction and registration',
'motionArcPaths':'Geometry construction and registration',
'replayCandidate':'Candidate replay and prefix validation',
'inspectTrajectory':'Trajectory/construction/impact assessment',
'inspectConstructionWindow':'Trajectory/construction/impact assessment',
'measureObjective':'Candidate objective and residuals',
'recordCandidate':'Candidate bookkeeping',
'reuseMeasurement':'Candidate memo reuse',
'withDetection':'Trajectory detection',
'detect':'Trajectory detection',
'nearestControls':'Model retrieval',
'arcControlProposals':'Model retrieval',
'finalizeArcTrack':'Finalization',
'openInterval':'Interval preparation',
'searchInterval':'Remaining interval search',
'compileArcMotionOnce':'Remaining compilation',
'compileHandoff':'Remaining compilation'}
measurement_modules={'detector.ts','strike_impact.ts','contact_impact.ts','motion_quality.ts','motion_objective.ts','motion_burst.ts','repertoire_realization.ts','repertoire_candidate.ts','repertoire_layout.ts','impact_accounts.ts','measure.ts','substrate.ts'}
geometry_modules={'arc_geometry.ts','arc.ts','primitive.ts'}
lookup_modules={'arc_memory.ts','arc_control_policy.ts'}
def path(url):
 return url.split('/source/')[-1] if '/source/' in url else url

def phase(stack):
 for f in reversed(stack):
  if f['functionName'] in phase_functions and f['url'].startswith('file:'):
   return phase_functions[f['functionName']]
 return 'Other setup/runtime'

def category(stack):
 leaf=stack[-1]; url=path(leaf['url']); name=leaf['functionName']
 if name=='(garbage collector)': return 'JavaScript garbage collection (unattributed)'
 if url==compiler_wasm:return 'Compiler native WASM'
 if url==judge_wasm:return 'Independent reference/judge WASM'
 if url.startswith('wasm:'):return 'Other WASM'
 if url.startswith('scripts/'):
  module=url.split('/')[-1].split('?')[0]
  if module in geometry_modules:return 'JavaScript geometry'
  if module in measurement_modules:return 'JavaScript trajectory/assessment'
  if module in lookup_modules:return 'JavaScript model retrieval'
  if '/native_motion/' in url:return 'JavaScript engine bridge'
  return 'Other compiler JavaScript'
 if url.startswith('tools/'):return 'Measurement runner'
 return 'Node/V8 runtime and unresolved builtins'

frames=[];frame_ids={};profiles=[];results={}
for cell in [61,62]:
 ddir=r/f'cell-{cell}'; files=sorted(ddir.glob('compile-*.cpuprofile')); assert len(files)==3
 totals=collections.Counter(); phases=collections.Counter(); inclusive=collections.Counter();native_entries=collections.Counter();native_leaves=collections.Counter();phasenative=collections.Counter();folded=collections.Counter();filtered=collections.Counter();perrun=[];excluded=0;time_total=0;time_kept=0;sample_count=0
 for file in files:
  d=json.loads(file.read_text());nodes={n['id']:n for n in d['nodes']};parents={c:n['id'] for n in d['nodes'] for c in n.get('children',[])}
  stacks={}
  def stack(n):
   if n not in stacks:
    stacks[n]=(stack(parents[n]) if n in parents else [])+[nodes[n]['callFrame']]
   return stacks[n]
  samples=[];weights=[];runcat=collections.Counter();runexcluded=0;runkept=0
  assert len(d['samples'])==len(d['timeDeltas'])
  for sample,dt in zip(d['samples'],d['timeDeltas']):
   assert dt>=0
   st=stack(sample);time_total+=dt;sample_count+=1
   iscontrol=any(f['url'].startswith('node:inspector') for f in st)
   labels=[];ids=[]
   for f in st:
    if f['functionName']=='(root)':continue
    fn=f['functionName'] or '(anonymous)';url=path(f['url']);match=re.fullmatch(r'wasm-function\[(\d+)\]',fn)
    if url==compiler_wasm and match and match[1] in exports:fn=exports[match[1]]+' ('+fn+')'
    label=fn+(' ['+url+']' if url else '')
    labels.append(label.replace(';',':'))
    key=(fn,url,f['lineNumber'],f['columnNumber'])
    if key not in frame_ids:
     frame_ids[key]=len(frames);frames.append({'name':fn,'file':url,'line':f['lineNumber']+1,'col':f['columnNumber']+1})
    ids.append(frame_ids[key])
   samples.append(ids);weights.append(dt);folded[';'.join(labels)]+=dt
   if iscontrol:excluded+=dt;runexcluded+=dt;continue
   filtered[';'.join(labels)]+=dt;time_kept+=dt;runkept+=dt
   cat=category(st);totals[cat]+=dt;runcat[cat]+=dt
   p='Garbage collection (unattributed)' if st[-1]['functionName']=='(garbage collector)' else phase(st)
   phases[p]+=dt
   if cat=='Compiler native WASM':phasenative[p]+=dt
   for k in set((f['functionName'] or '(anonymous)',path(f['url'])) for f in st if f['functionName']!='(root)'):
    inclusive[k]+=dt
   native=[f for f in st if f['url']==compiler_wasm]
   if native:
    native_entries[native[0]['functionName']]+=dt
    if cat=='Compiler native WASM':native_leaves[st[-1]['functionName']]+=dt
  perrun.append({'file':file.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'profileSpanUs':d['endTime']-d['startTime'],'weightedUs':sum(d['timeDeltas']),'keptUs':runkept,'profilerControlUs':runexcluded,'categoriesPct':{k:100*v/runkept for k,v in runcat.most_common()}})
  profiles.append({'type':'sampled','name':f'cell {cell} / {file.stem}','unit':'microseconds','startValue':0,'endValue':sum(weights),'samples':samples,'weights':weights})
 assert sum(totals.values())==time_kept and sum(phases.values())==time_kept
 def rows(c):return [{'name':k,'msPerCompile':v/3000,'pctOfNonProfilerSamples':100*v/time_kept} for k,v in c.most_common()]
 result={'cell':cell,'samples':sample_count,'totalSampledMsPerCompile':time_total/3000,'profilerControlMsPerCompile':excluded/3000,'nonProfilerSampledMsPerCompile':time_kept/3000,'categories':rows(totals),'exclusivePhases':rows(phases),'nativeTimeByPhase':rows(phasenative),'nativeEntryInclusive':rows(native_entries),'nativeSelf':rows(native_leaves),'inclusiveCallers':[{'function':k[0],'url':k[1],'msPerCompile':v/3000,'pctOfNonProfilerSamples':100*v/time_kept} for k,v in inclusive.most_common(60)],'runs':perrun,'measurements':json.loads((ddir/'result.json').read_text())}
 results[str(cell)]=result
 for suffix,data in [('all',folded),('application',filtered)]:
  dest=ddir/f'{suffix}.folded';dest.write_text(''.join(f'{k} {v}\n' for k,v in sorted(data.items()) if v))
  with open(ddir/f'{suffix}.svg','w') as out:
   subprocess.run(['perl',str(r/'flamegraph.pl'),'--title',f'Automatic cell {cell}: {suffix} sampled stacks','--subtitle','214e38a8 | 3 compiles after 1 warmup | V8 CPU sampler 250 us | diagnostic only','--countname','microseconds','--width','1600','--hash',str(dest)],stdout=out,check=True)
 (ddir/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['cell','nonProfilerSampledMsPerCompile','profilerControlMsPerCompile','categories','exclusivePhases','nativeEntryInclusive']},indent=2))
(r/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
(r/'cost-map.speedscope.json').write_text(json.dumps({'$schema':'https://www.speedscope.app/file-format-schema.json','name':'214e38a8 compiler cost map','exporter':'V8 inspector + engine-cost-map-20261104/analyze.py','shared':{'frames':frames},'profiles':profiles,'activeProfileIndex':0})+'\n')
